meaning.en: Shaunaka, a great and learned householder
meaning.hi: शौनक, एक महान गृहस्थ-विद्वान

meaning.en: asked the revered Pippalada, descendant of Angiras
meaning.hi: अंगिरस के वंशज, आदरणीय पिप्पलाद से पूछा

meaning.en: beings settled in the divine city of Brahman
meaning.hi: ब्रह्म की दिव्य नगरी में बसे प्राणी

meaning.en: how do they create, how does creation happen
meaning.hi: सृष्टि कैसे होती है

meaning.en: whose greatness has this come to be
meaning.hi: यह महिमा किसकी हुई है

words.sanskrit: yah hi esha mahima babhuva kah eshah

meaning.en: this greatness that arose — what is it
meaning.hi: यह जो महिमा उत्पन्न हुई — यह क्या है

meaning.en: to him he said (Pippalada answered)
meaning.hi: उससे उसने कहा (पिप्पलाद ने उत्तर दिया)

meaning.en: the highest branch of sacred knowledge
meaning.hi: ब्रह्मविद्या की सर्वोच्च शाखा

meaning.en: this breath of life is indeed the self
meaning.hi: यह प्राण ही आत्मा है

meaning.en: the self's greatness became the gods' lifespan
meaning.hi: आत्मा की महिमा ही देवताओं की आयु बनी

meaning.en: he is the gods' passing, yet himself beyond passing
meaning.hi: वह देवताओं का अंत है, पर स्वयं अंत-रहित

words.sanskrit: divye brahmapure virajam nishkalam shubhram aksharam

meaning.en: in the divine city of Brahman: pure, without parts, radiant, imperishable
meaning.hi: ब्रह्म की दिव्य नगरी में: शुद्ध, अंश-रहित, तेजस्वी, अविनाशी

meaning.en: that which shines as Brahman
meaning.hi: जो ब्रह्म के रूप में चमकता है

meaning.en: he governs, he controls
meaning.hi: वह नियंत्रित करता है

meaning.en: the way a queen bee governs the swarm of bees
meaning.hi: जैसे रानी मक्खी मधुमक्खियों के झुंड को नियंत्रित करती है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: yatha makshika ekena tantuna jalam vakshipati

meaning.en: just as a spider spins its web with a single thread
meaning.hi: जैसे मकड़ी एक ही तंतु से जाल बुनती है

meaning.en: and draws it back with that same thread
meaning.hi: और उसी से उसे वापस खींचती है

meaning.en: so too does this life-breath
meaning.hi: वैसे ही यह प्राण

meaning.en: when it goes, drawing the gathered (senses) back in
meaning.hi: जब यह जाता है, इकट्ठे (इंद्रियों) को खींचकर

meaning.en: the breath's deities dwell in all the channels (nadis)
meaning.hi: प्राण की देवताएँ सभी नाड़ियों में हैं

meaning.en: in deep sleep, like a hawk in open sky
meaning.hi: गहरी नींद में, आकाश में बाज़ की तरह

words.sanskrit: yatha kham shyenam ashritya yati svam alayam

meaning.en: as the hawk in the sky returns to its own nest
meaning.hi: जैसे आकाश में बाज़ अपने घोंसले में लौटता है

meaning.en: so the one in deep sleep is described
meaning.hi: वैसे ही गहरी नींद में वह वर्णित है

words.sanskrit: yatha eva eshah devadattah yashtya api tadyamanah na yati

meaning.en: just as Devadatta, even if struck by a stick, is not disturbed
meaning.hi: जैसे देवदत्त, छड़ी से मारे जाने पर भी, विचलित नहीं होता

meaning.en: so too, not touched by good or bad actions
meaning.hi: वैसे ही शुभ-अशुभ कर्मों से अछूता रहता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: just as a child, free of desire, moves easily into joy
meaning.hi: जैसे बालक, इच्छा-रहित, सहजता से आनंद में जाता है

words.sanskrit: tatha eva eshah devadattah svapne anandam abhi yati

meaning.en: so too Devadatta moves into the joy of dreaming
meaning.hi: वैसे ही देवदत्त स्वप्न के आनंद में जाता है

meaning.en: the Vedas themselves are the supreme light
meaning.hi: वेद स्वयं परम ज्योति हैं

meaning.en: the light delights one who longs for that light
meaning.hi: जो प्रकाश चाहता है उसे प्रकाश ही आनंदित करता है

meaning.en: then, by that very light, moves again toward dreaming
meaning.hi: फिर उसी प्रकाश से स्वप्न की ओर जाता है

meaning.en: like a small water-leech (adjusting its path)
meaning.hi: जल-जोंक की तरह (अपनी दिशा बदलते हुए)

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: just as a leech moves forward, tip by tip
meaning.hi: जैसे जोंक आगे-आगे बढ़ती है

meaning.en: carries itself forward, having secured the next hold
meaning.hi: अगली पकड़ बनाकर स्वयं को आगे ले जाती है

meaning.en: not releasing the earlier hold until the next is secured
meaning.hi: अगली पकड़ के बिना पिछली नहीं छोड़ती

meaning.en: that (steady presence) is called the waking state
meaning.hi: वही (स्थिर उपस्थिति) जाग्रत अवस्था कहलाती है

meaning.en: just as it gathers together the eightfold perception
meaning.hi: जैसे यह अनुभूति के आठों अंगों को समेटता है

words.sanskrit: tam eva stana iva lambate veda-devayonah

meaning.en: hanging complete, like a fruit, from the very source of the Vedas
meaning.hi: वेदों के स्रोत से फल की तरह लटका हुआ, पूर्ण

words.sanskrit: yatra jagrati shubha-ashubham niruktam asya devasya

meaning.en: where this waking state stands clear of good and evil
meaning.hi: जहाँ यह जाग्रत अवस्था शुभ-अशुभ से स्पष्ट खड़ी है

words.sanskrit: sah samprasarah antaryami khagah karkatakah pushkarah purushah pranah

meaning.en: that is called the pervader, the inner controller, the mover, the deepest self, the breath
meaning.hi: वही सर्वव्यापी, अंतर्यामी, गतिमान, गहनतम आत्मा, प्राण कहलाता है

words.sanskrit: hinsa parapararam brahma atma devata vedayati

meaning.en: reveals the self as the highest and nearest Brahman, the deity
meaning.hi: आत्मा को परम और निकटतम ब्रह्म, देवता के रूप में प्रकट करता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: whoever knows this in this way
meaning.hi: जो कोई इसे इस प्रकार जानता है

words.sanskrit: sah param brahma dham kshetrajnam upaiti

meaning.en: reaches the supreme Brahman, the knower present within the field
meaning.hi: वह परम ब्रह्म, क्षेत्र के भीतर विद्यमान ज्ञाता को प्राप्त करता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: all the divine powers rest within the heart
meaning.hi: सभी दिव्य शक्तियाँ हृदय में टिकी हैं

meaning.en: the currents of life (prana) are anchored in the heart
meaning.hi: प्राण हृदय में प्रतिष्ठित हैं

meaning.en: in the heart, both the life-breath and its radiance
meaning.hi: हृदय में प्राण और ज्योति दोनों

meaning.en: the great threefold cord that arises from this
meaning.hi: वह महान त्रिवृत डोरी जो इससे उठती है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: pure awareness itself sits within the heart
meaning.hi: शुद्ध चेतना स्वयं हृदय में बैठी है

meaning.en: the highest, most sacred thread
meaning.hi: सर्वोच्च, सबसे पवित्र डोरा

meaning.en: that which was, from the beginning, natural to Prajapati
meaning.hi: जो आरंभ से प्रजापति के स्वाभाविक रूप से जुड़ा था

meaning.en: may this radiant thread, bearing long life, be worn
meaning.hi: यह तेजस्वी, दीर्घायु देने वाला डोरा धारण किया जाए

meaning.en: may strength and radiance rest in it
meaning.hi: बल और तेज इसमें रहें

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: having, in a manner of speaking, shaved (the outer mark)
meaning.hi: बाहरी चिह्न मानो मुँड़ाकर

meaning.en: the wise one should abandon the outer thread
meaning.hi: ज्ञानी बाहरी डोरे को त्याग दे

meaning.en: that which is the imperishable, supreme Brahman
meaning.hi: जो अविनाशी, परम ब्रह्म है

meaning.en: one should hold that alone as the true thread
meaning.hi: उसी को सच्चा डोरा मानकर धारण करे

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: they call it 'thread' because it points, indicates
meaning.hi: इसे 'सूत्र' इसलिए कहा जाता है क्योंकि यह इशारा करता है

meaning.en: the thread's very name means the highest state
meaning.hi: सूत्र नाम का अर्थ ही परम पद है

meaning.en: by whom that thread is truly known
meaning.hi: जिसके द्वारा वह सूत्र सचमुच जाना गया

meaning.en: he is the learned one who has gone beyond the Vedas
meaning.hi: वही विप्र वेदों से परे पहुँच चुका है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: through this, all of this is strung together
meaning.hi: इसी के द्वारा यह सब पिरोया गया है

meaning.en: like a cluster of beads on a thread
meaning.hi: जैसे मनकों का समूह डोरे पर

meaning.en: the yogi holds onto that thread
meaning.hi: योगी उस डोरे को धारण करता है

meaning.en: one who knows yoga and has seen the underlying truth
meaning.hi: जो योग जानता है और तत्त्व को देख चुका है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the learned one abandons the outer thread
meaning.hi: विद्वान बाहरी डोरे को त्याग देता है

meaning.en: one who is established in the highest yoga
meaning.hi: जो योग की सर्वोच्च अवस्था में स्थित है

meaning.en: should hold the thread made of the very nature of Brahman
meaning.hi: ब्रह्म-भाव से बने डोरे को धारण करे

meaning.en: whoever does so is truly conscious, aware
meaning.hi: जो ऐसा करता है वही सच में चेतन है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: by holding fast to that thread
meaning.hi: उस डोरे को दृढ़ता से धारण करने से

meaning.en: one does not become stained by leftover impurity
meaning.hi: व्यक्ति बची अशुद्धि से मलिन नहीं होता

meaning.en: for those whose thread runs entirely within
meaning.hi: जिनका डोरा पूरी तरह भीतर बहता है

meaning.en: those whose sacred thread is knowledge itself
meaning.hi: जिनका पवित्र डोरा स्वयं ज्ञान है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: they are the true knowers of the thread in this world
meaning.hi: वे इस संसार में सच्चे डोरे के ज्ञाता हैं

meaning.en: they are the true wearers of the sacred cord
meaning.hi: वे ही सच्चे यज्ञोपवीतधारी हैं

meaning.en: their tuft is knowledge, they are grounded in knowledge
meaning.hi: उनकी शिखा ज्ञान है, वे ज्ञान में स्थित हैं

meaning.en: their sacred thread, truly, is knowledge
meaning.hi: उनका पवित्र डोरा वास्तव में ज्ञान है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: for them, knowledge alone is the highest
meaning.hi: उनके लिए ज्ञान ही सर्वोच्च है

meaning.en: pure and supreme knowledge
meaning.hi: शुद्ध और परम ज्ञान

meaning.en: just as fire has only one flame, no other
meaning.hi: जैसे अग्नि की एक ही लौ, कोई दूसरी नहीं

meaning.en: whoever's tuft (flame) is made of knowledge
meaning.hi: जिसकी शिखा (लौ) ज्ञान से बनी है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: that person alone is called truly crested, the wise one
meaning.hi: वही व्यक्ति सच में शिखायुक्त, ज्ञानी कहलाता है

meaning.en: others are merely wearers of hair
meaning.hi: बाकी लोग केवल बाल धारण करने वाले हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: karmani adhikritah ye tu vaidike brahmana-adayah

meaning.en: those authorized for Vedic ritual duty, like priests
meaning.hi: जो वैदिक कर्मकांड के अधिकारी हैं, जैसे ब्राह्मण आदि

meaning.en: by them, this thread should still be held
meaning.hi: उनके द्वारा यह डोरा धारण किया जाना चाहिए

meaning.en: it is remembered as a necessary limb of ritual performance
meaning.hi: यह कर्मकांड का आवश्यक अंग माना गया है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: whoever's tuft is made of knowledge
meaning.hi: जिसकी शिखा ज्ञान से बनी है

meaning.en: and whose sacred thread is likewise of that same knowledge
meaning.hi: और जिसका डोरा भी उसी ज्ञान से बना है

meaning.en: that person has attained the complete essence of priesthood
meaning.hi: उसने पुरोहितत्व का पूर्ण सारतत्व पाया है

meaning.en: so declare those who truly know Brahman
meaning.hi: ऐसा ब्रह्म के ज्ञाता कहते हैं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: this sacred thread, truly pure
meaning.hi: यह पवित्र डोरा, सचमुच शुद्ध

meaning.en: that toward which one's whole life is oriented
meaning.hi: जिसकी ओर सारा जीवन उन्मुख है

meaning.en: whoever embraces it becomes a learned wearer of the thread
meaning.hi: जो इसे अपनाता है वह ज्ञानी डोरा-धारक बनता है

meaning.en: he becomes the sacrifice itself, and the knower of sacrifice
meaning.hi: वह स्वयं यज्ञ बनता है, और यज्ञ का ज्ञाता

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: one divine reality, hidden within all beings
meaning.hi: एक दिव्य सत्ता, सभी प्राणियों में छिपी हुई

meaning.en: all-pervading, the innermost self of every being
meaning.hi: सर्वव्यापी, हर प्राणी की अंतरात्मा

meaning.en: presiding over action, dwelling within all beings
meaning.hi: कर्म की अध्यक्षता करने वाला, सभी प्राणियों में निवास करने वाला

meaning.en: the witness, consciousness, complete and alone, without qualities
meaning.hi: साक्षी, चेतन, संपूर्ण और अकेला, निर्गुण

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: one wise presence behind the many who act selflessly
meaning.hi: निष्काम कर्म करने वाले अनेकों के पीछे एक ज्ञानी

meaning.en: being one, makes itself appear as many
meaning.hi: एक होते हुए, स्वयं को अनेक रूप में प्रकट करता है

meaning.en: the steady ones who truly perceive that self
meaning.hi: जो स्थिर लोग उस आत्मा को सचमुच देखते हैं

meaning.en: for them, lasting peace; not for others
meaning.hi: उनके लिए शाश्वत शांति; औरों के लिए नहीं

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: taking the self as the lower fire-stick
meaning.hi: आत्मा को निचली अरणी बनाकर

meaning.en: and the syllable Om as the upper fire-stick
meaning.hi: और प्रणव को ऊपरी अरणी बनाकर

meaning.en: through the practice of meditative friction
meaning.hi: ध्यान-मंथन के अभ्यास से

meaning.en: one comes to see the divine, otherwise deeply hidden
meaning.hi: उस दिव्य को देखता है जो अन्यथा गहरे छिपा है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: as oil in sesame seeds, as butter in curd
meaning.hi: जैसे तिलों में तेल, दही में मक्खन

meaning.en: as water in springs, as fire within kindling wood
meaning.hi: जैसे स्रोतों में जल, अरणियों में अग्नि

meaning.en: so too is the self grasped within the self
meaning.hi: वैसे ही आत्मा आत्मा के भीतर ग्रहण की जाती है

words.sanskrit: asau satyena enam tapasa yah anupashyati

meaning.en: by whoever perceives it through truthfulness and disciplined effort
meaning.hi: जो सत्य और तप से इसे देखता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

words.sanskrit: urnanabhih yatha tantun srijate samharati api

meaning.en: as a spider spins threads out and draws them back
meaning.hi: जैसे मकड़ी तंतु बुनती है और वापस खींचती है

meaning.en: so too the living self, between waking and dreaming
meaning.hi: वैसे ही जीव, जाग्रति और स्वप्न के बीच

meaning.en: goes out and comes back again
meaning.hi: बाहर जाता है और फिर लौट आता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: resembling the closed bud of a lotus
meaning.hi: कमल की बंद कली के समान

meaning.en: hollow inside, and turned somewhat downward
meaning.hi: भीतर खोखला, और कुछ नीचे की ओर मुड़ा

meaning.en: one should understand the heart as this
meaning.hi: हृदय को इस रूप में समझना चाहिए

meaning.en: the great dwelling place of the whole universe
meaning.hi: समस्त ब्रह्मांड का महान आवास

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: know the self in the eyes as belonging to the waking state
meaning.hi: आँखों में स्थित आत्मा को जाग्रत अवस्था का जानें

meaning.en: the self in the throat should be pointed to as the dream state
meaning.hi: कंठ में स्थित को स्वप्न अवस्था का माना जाए

meaning.en: the self in the heart belongs to deep, dreamless sleep
meaning.hi: हृदय में स्थित सुषुप्ति अवस्था की है

meaning.en: the fourth state is established at the crown of the head
meaning.hi: तुरीय अवस्था सिर के शीर्ष पर स्थित है

words.sanskrit: yada atma prajnaya atmanam sandhatte paramatmani

meaning.en: when the self, through wisdom, unites itself with the supreme self
meaning.hi: जब आत्मा प्रज्ञा से स्वयं को परमात्मा से जोड़ती है

meaning.en: that union itself is the true twilight meditation
meaning.hi: वही मिलन सच्ची संध्या-साधना है

meaning.en: therefore it deserves to be honoured as the sandhya prayer
meaning.hi: इसीलिए इसे संध्या-वंदन के रूप में सम्मानित किया जाए

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the meditative union free of ordinary effort
meaning.hi: सामान्य प्रयास से मुक्त ध्यानपूर्ण मिलन

meaning.en: free of the strain of speech and bodily action
meaning.hi: वाणी और शरीर के परिश्रम से मुक्त

meaning.en: the union that joins together all beings
meaning.hi: जो सभी प्राणियों को जोड़ता है

meaning.en: this is the true twilight practice of the true renunciates
meaning.hi: यही सच्चे संन्यासियों की सायं-साधना है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: that from which speech turns back
meaning.hi: जिससे वाणी लौट आती है

meaning.en: unable to reach it, along with the mind
meaning.hi: उस तक पहुँच न पाकर, मन सहित

meaning.en: this is the joy that belongs to the individual self
meaning.hi: यही व्यष्टि-आत्मा का आनंद है

meaning.en: knowing which, the wise one is released, freed
meaning.hi: जिसे जानकर ज्ञानी मुक्त हो जाता है

verification.notes: Word-by-word gloss read against the verse's own Sanskrit; each entry is a plain-language meaning, not a grammatical parse.

meaning.en: the self, present everywhere at once
meaning.hi: वह आत्मा, जो हर जगह एक साथ उपस्थित है

meaning.en: held within all things as nourishment is held within milk
meaning.hi: दूध में घी की तरह सब में समाई हुई

meaning.en: the very root of inner discipline — this is the highest teaching of the Upanishads
meaning.hi: आत्म-तप की जड़ — यही उपनिषदों की सर्वोच्च शिक्षा है

meaning.en: seen in the form of the oneness of the self of everything
meaning.hi: सर्व-आत्मा की एकता के रूप में देखा गया

meaning.en: this, again, is the highest teaching of the Upanishads
meaning.hi: यही, फिर, उपनिषदों की सर्वोच्च शिक्षा है
